title: Commons LEARN: a curriculum path
description: A view definition of core-views (R5) of kind curriculum: one path through the body of knowledge, its sections read in order (learn R2).

promise.description: what the learner can do after the path

way_back.description: where a learner's question or a found error goes (learn R6)

sections.description: blueprint section ids (core-views R1), read in order

after.description: the paths a learner should have read first
